resultDisplay.originalContent:
The build fails because the submodules (auto-common, auto-factory, auto-service, auto-value) depend on `auto-parent` version `3`.
`auto-parent` version `3` (downloaded from Maven Central) contains a system dependency on `tools.jar` which is expected to be at `${java.home}/../lib/tools.jar`.
This path is valid for Java 8, but invalid for Java 9+ (including Java 11 which is running the build), as `tools.jar` was removed.
The local `auto-parent` (`pom.xml` in the root) is version `4-SNAPSHOT` and has updated configuration (using a profile) to only look for `tools.jar` if it exists.
However, the submodules are not using this new parent; they are pointing to the old version `3`.

To fix this, we need to update the `pom.xml` of all submodules to use `auto-parent` version `4-SNAPSHOT`.
This will ensure they inherit the correct build configuration compatible with Java 11.
